subject: MAP: Data controls, audit trail & PHI handling — draft milestones and owners
messages:
From: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@medtechplus.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP — data handling scope (post-call)

Thanks for the call earlier today — quick recap and a first pass at what we'd like to see in a Mutual Action Plan focused on data handling. High level needs: retention policy for user transcripts and logs, immutable audit trail for access to PHI/PII, and retention of inference logs for 12 months for clinical QA.

Attached is our consolidated requirements doc (security@medtechplus.com helped compile). Can you (Redwood) propose milestones + owners for: retention policy confirmation, logging & audit trail delivery, legal/contract redlines for PHI, and production deployment gating (private VPC or dedicated)?

Target: We are aiming for vendor selection & contract signature by mid-December but that depends on SOC2 evidence and legal review. Please include dependencies and any items that require our legal/procurement input.

Thanks,
Sarah Coleman
Director of IT Security — MedTech Plus
security@medtechplus.com

Attachments: requirements-summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@medtechplus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP — data handling scope (post-call)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear list. I've drafted a short MAP worksheet attached (MAP-draft-data-controls.xlsx) with milestone names, proposed owners, target dates, and dependencies. High-level suggestions below — we can iterate: 

- Milestone 1: Retention policy decision (metadata + full transcript)
  - Owner: MedTech Plus (legal) / Redwood (ops)
  - Target: 2026-12-01
  - Dependency: Legal approval on retention windows and data-subject requirements

- Milestone 2: Logging & immutable audit trail delivery (format + storage)
  - Owner: Redwood (engineering) / MedTech Plus (security)
  - Target: 2026-12-08
  - Dependency: Agreement on retention period (see options below) and method (append-only logs vs. WORM storage)

- Milestone 3: PHI/PII handling & contract redlines (clauses + responsibilities)
  - Owner: MedTech Plus (legal) / Redwood (contracts)
  - Target: 2026-12-10
  - Dependency: SOC2 report & DPA language review; procurement sign-off

- Milestone 4: Deployment gating & final sign-off (private VPC or Dedicated)
  - Owner: MedTech Plus (cloud infra) / Redwood (solutions)
  - Target: 2026-12-15 (target close date)
  - Dependency: Network configuration, key management (KMS) integration, and verified audit logs

Retention options I included in the sheet: 90 days (default), 365 days (clinical QA), and custom escrow for long-term audit copies. For audit trails we propose tokenized access logs with a 365-day retention; for PHI we recommend encryption-at-rest + HSM-backed key control.

Next steps: 1) Sarah — can you confirm which retention option you want in the MAP? 2) Marissa/Karthik — I'll assign engineers and upload the log sample (SFTP-logging-sample.txt) to the Drive link.

– Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP-draft-data-controls.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@medtechplus.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP — data handling scope (follow-up: logging format)

Sarah / team — following up on the logging/audit trail piece. A few concrete notes from engineering that will help you decide: 

- Default log schema we can provide: timestamp, request_id, model_variant, redaction_flag, hashed_user_id (SHA-256), token_count, response_checksum. Full transcript retention is configurable and can be stored off-cluster if required.
- For PHI-sensitive content we offer: on-the-fly PII classifiers + automatic redaction and separate encrypted bucket with HSM keys that only your key-owner can rotate.
- Audit trail options: (A) append-only object store with immutability flag (requires cloud-side retention policy), (B) Write Once Read Many (WORM) through third-party archive (adds latency for retrieval).

If MedTech needs a sample export of the log format, I've attached a small SFTP log sample. Also: if you plan to keep inference logs for 12 months for QA, we recommend allowing read-only access to your data-science team and a quarterly snapshot to your S3 archive (or equivalent).

Two asks from Redwood ops: 1) confirmation of the preferred retention window (90/365/custom) and 2) whether MedTech prefers Redwood-managed key rotation or customer-managed keys (we support both).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Integrations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SFTP-logging-sample.txt (txt, 3KB)

From: Sarah Coleman <sarah.coleman@medtechplus.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@medtechplus.com, security@medtechplus.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Data controls, audit trail & PHI handling — draft milestones and owners

Thanks — this is very helpful and a clean way to structure the MAP. Quick answers: 

- Retention: we need transcripts and inference logs retained for 365 days as default (clinical QA requirement). Shorter windows are acceptable only for non-clinical test tenants.
- Keys: MedTech will require customer-managed keys (KMS) for PHI buckets.
- Audit trail: prefer option (A) append-only with immutability flag in our archive; retrieval latency tolerable up to 24 hours.

Dependencies on our side: legal will circulate redlines by 2026-12-02, procurement will confirm contract approver by 2026-12-04. SOC2 evidence — we need Redwood's most recent report (or the SOC2 bridge letter) by 2026-12-02 to start legal's final pass.

Target close date: MedTech internal target is 2026-12-15. If Redwood can confirm owners and update the MAP spreadsheet with the agreed retention values, we'll mark milestones as accepted and route to procurement.

Thanks — Sarah
